blurb: Guests can take riding lessons in an outdoor arena year-round, weather permitting and above 20 degrees, with instruction progressing from arena to outside riding. Equine Assisted Psychotherapy (EAP) and Equine Assisted Learning (EAL) sessions are available for emotional growth and learning, involving cooperation between mental health and horse professionals. Various group programs and specialized events can be tailored to client needs.
extraNote: Cancellation requires 24-hour notice or $40 fee applies · Payment expected at time of service; cash and check preferred, Venmo accepted with 2% fee · Insurance billing available for Equine Assisted Psychotherapy · Year-round, weather permitting and above 20 degrees for riding lessons
